jobDescription:
Job Title: Threat Intelligence Analyst - Associate

Location: Mumbai, India

Corporate Title: AS

Role Description

  • The Threat Intelligence Analyst role sits within the Threat Intelligence function in the Chief Security Office (CSO), which works to proactively detect and disrupt physical and cyber threats against Deutsche Bank as part of its mission to be a threat-driven organisation. This role is primarily focused on physical threat intelligence, while remaining aligned with the broader threat intelligence mandate.
  • The Physical Threat Intelligence Analyst is responsible for proactively identifying, monitoring, analysing, and assessing physical security threats that could affect the organisation s people, assets, operations, reputation, and overall resilience. The role requires systematic collection and evaluation of intelligence from a broad range of sources, including open-source reporting, vendor intelligence, professional networks, and internal stakeholders. By monitoring global, regional, and local risk developments, the analyst produces timely, actionable, and clearly articulated threat assessments that support security operations, executive decision-making, crisis management, incident response, and business continuity planning. This position plays a critical role in helping the organisation anticipate emerging risks, understand their potential business impact, and implement appropriate mitigation measures in a dynamic threat environment.
  • This is an emerging leadership role suited to a candidate with prior experience managing intelligence analysts, developing team capability, and delivering time-sensitive intelligence products in support of Regional Intelligence Analysts across Deutsche Bank.
  • In addition to producing high-quality analysis, the candidate will lead the Information Processing & Research team (IPR), an internal team formed within the Threat Intelligence function. The IPR team transforms structured and unstructured data from multiple sources into high-quality intelligence, enabling data-driven threat identification and informed decision-making through robust collection and validation processes. The team partners with regional analysts through an intelligence-led approach to deliver actionable insights and identify key threat drivers, trends, and patterns across relevant areas of focus.

What we ll offer you

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you ll enjoy

  • Best in class leave policy
  • Gender neutral parental leaves
  • 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
  • Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
  • Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
  • Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
  • Accident and Term life Insurance
  • Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above

Your key responsibilities

  • Threat Monitoring and Intelligence Collection
    • Identify, monitor, and report on geopolitical, regional, and local developments that may affect business operations, personnel, facilities, executive travel, and critical assets.
    • Collect and assess threat intelligence from HUMINT and OSINT sources, including vendors, professional networks, industry associations, social media, news feeds, commercial intelligence platforms, and other relevant sources.
    • Monitor physical security threats, including terrorism, crime, civil unrest, political instability, insider threats, targeted violence, and other emerging risk indicators.
  • Analysis, Reporting, and Intelligence Products
    • Conduct geopolitical, regional, and country risk analysis to identify emerging threats, operational impacts, trends, patterns, and relevant threat actors.
    • Produce timely intelligence reports, alerts, threat assessments, watchlists, and risk dashboards for stakeholders, leadership teams, and operational partners.
    • Deliver tactical and strategic intelligence through verbal briefings, presentations, written reports, and executive-level recommendations that support risk mitigation strategies.
  • Crisis, Incident, and Business Continuity Support
    • Provide time-critical intelligence during crisis events, emergencies, business continuity incidents, and security incidents to support informed decision-making and operational response.
    • Actively engage with crisis management teams and support security incident investigations through intelligence collection, analysis, and reporting.
  • Collaboration, Methodology, and Standards
    • Collaborate with Corporate Security, Global Security Operations Centers, crisis management teams, information security operations, and external security partners.
    • Maintain intelligence databases, analytical methodologies, and reporting standards to ensure consistency, accuracy, and quality across intelligence products.

Your skills and experience

  • Subject-Matter Expertise
    • Strong knowledge of global geopolitics, international relations, and regional security dynamics, with particular focus on Asia Pacific and South Asia.
    • Experience in corporate intelligence operations, including coverage of terrorism, political and social unrest, epidemiological developments, natural hazards, and other relevant security risks.
  • Analytical Capability and Intelligence Production
    • Sound understanding of the intelligence life cycle, including collection, validation, analysis, production, and dissemination.
    • Ability to identify trends, patterns, threat actors, and indicators that may affect organisational operations, personnel, facilities, executive travel, and critical assets.
    • Ability to prepare clear intelligence products, executive-level briefings, and recommendations that support practical risk mitigation.
  • Tools, Sources, and Methodology
    • Experience using open-source intelligence, social media monitoring, news feeds, commercial intelligence platforms, and other relevant sources to identify threat indicators.
    • Experience maintaining intelligence databases, analytical methodologies, and reporting standards would be advantageous.
  • Stakeholder Engagement and Operational Support
    • Experience working with incident response, crisis management, business continuity, or security operations teams.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex issues clearly and effectively to English-speaking stakeholders.

Character/Professionalism

  • Professional Judgement and Integrity
    • Demonstrates a high level of personal integrity, initiative, objectivity, and professionalism.
    • Maintains sound judgement and composure under pressure while remaining focused on required operational outcomes.
  • Collaboration and Influence
    • Builds effective working relationships and demonstrates strong interpersonal skills, including the ability to influence, collaborate, and negotiate constructively.
    • Works effectively in high-performing, multicultural, and globally distributed teams.
  • Ownership, Delivery, and Development
    • Takes ownership of tasks, prioritises effectively, and delivers high-quality outputs within strict deadlines.
    • Works independently with minimal supervision while maintaining accountability for outcomes.
    • Demonstrates commitment to ongoing professional development and to building capability in line with role requirements.

Qualifications

  • Education and Professional Experience
    • Master s degree in a relevant field, such as political science, international relations, history, security studies, or related discipline.
    • At least five years of experience in the security industry, geopolitical intelligence, threat intelligence, or a related analytical field.
    • Experience in the financial services industry would be advantageous.

Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

How we ll support you

  • Training and development to help you excel in your career
  • Coaching and support from experts in your team
  • A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
  • A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

jobDescription:
Hello, We are Hiring Partnership Manager API & Strategic Partnerships at Link Publishers Pvt. Ltd

Experience: 3 5 Years
Department: Sales & Partnerships
Location: Ahmedabad
Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role

We are looking for a Partnership Manager API & Strategic Partnerships who can identify and build partnerships with SEO products, SaaS platforms, agencies, and other digital marketing businesses.

The primary responsibility of this role is to identify companies where the Link Publishers API can be integrated into their existing product or where our platform can be offered as a white-label link-building solution under the partners own brand.

This is not a traditional sales role focused on mass cold outreach. We are looking for someone who can research a product, understand how it works, identify where Link Publishers fits into its ecosystem, and then approach the right decision-maker with a personalized partnership proposition.

Key Responsibilities 1. Identify API Partnership Opportunities

Research and identify SEO tools, SaaS products, marketing platforms, backlink tools, content platforms, AI SEO tools, agency software, and other relevant products where the Link Publishers API can add value.

You will be expected to:

1/ Understand what the target product does and who its customers are.
2/ Explore the product, website, features, pricing, and existing integrations.
3/ Identify where link-building capabilities can fit naturally into the product.
4/ Develop a clear use case for integrating the Link Publishers API.
5/ Identify the right companies based on partnership potential rather than simply building large prospect lists.

For example, if an SEO platform helps users identify backlink opportunities but doesnt provide a way to actually purchase or execute those placements, you should be able to identify how Link Publishers can potentially fill that gap through an API integration.

2. Build White-Label Partnerships

Identify companies that want to offer link-building services to their customers without building their own publisher network or fulfillment infrastructure.

The goal is to position Link Publishers as their backend link-building partner while they continue selling the service under their own brand name.

Potential partners may include:

1/ SEO agencies
2/ Digital marketing agencies
3/ SaaS companies
4/ SEO platforms
5/ Content marketing platforms
6/ Reseller businesses
7/ Enterprise SEO service providers

You will understand their existing business model and propose a white-label partnership that makes commercial sense for both companies.

3. CXO & Decision-Maker Outreach

Identify and connect with relevant decision-makers, including:

Founders, Co-Founders, CEOs, CMOs, Heads of SEO, Heads of Partnerships, Product Heads, Business Heads, and other senior stakeholders.

The role requires thoughtful outreach rather than sending generic templates.

Before contacting a prospect, you should understand:

What does their company do Where can Link Publishers fit What value can we add Who is the right person to approach What should the partnership proposal look like

4. Personalized Email Outreach

Strong email writing is one of the most important requirements for this position.

You should be able to research a product and write a personalized email explaining exactly how an API integration or white-label partnership could benefit their business.

We are not looking for generic emails such as:

"We provide link-building services and would love to explore a partnership."

Instead, outreach should demonstrate that you have understood the prospects product and identified a genuine integration opportunity.

Emails should be concise, personalized, commercially relevant, and written to generate conversations with senior decision-makers.

5. Partnership Discussions & Closure

Once a prospect shows interest, you will own the partnership conversation from initial discussion to closure.

This includes:

1/ Understanding the partners requirements
2/ Conducting discovery calls
3/ Presenting relevant API/white-label solutions
4/ Coordinating product demonstrations
5/ Discussing commercial models
6/ Coordinating technical discussions with internal teams
7/ Following up with stakeholders
8/ Managing NDA/documentation requirements
9/ Moving opportunities toward integration and launch

You do not need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable understanding how APIs work from a business and product perspective.

What Were Looking For

Experience: 3 5 years in Partnerships, Business Development, SaaS Sales, Strategic Alliances, API Partnerships, SEO SaaS, or a similar role.

The ideal candidate should have:

1/ Strong understanding of SaaS products and online business models.
2/ Good understanding of SEO and link building.
3/ Ability to research and understand new products independently.
4/ Ability to identify API integration opportunities.
5/ Experience communicating with founders and CXO-level stakeholders.
6/ Excellent written English and email communication.
7/ Strong personalization and cold outreach skills.
8/ Ability to convert product research into a compelling partnership proposition.
9/ Confidence conducting discovery and partnership calls.
10/ Strong follow-up and relationship-management skills.
11/ Commercial mindset and ability to think beyond traditional sales.

Technical Understanding

You do not need to code for this role.

However, you should understand basic concepts such as:

API integrations, SaaS platforms, data exchange, product integrations, white-label solutions, marketplaces, and reseller models.

You should be able to communicate a potential integration use case clearly enough for product and technical teams to take the discussion forward.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured simply by the number of emails sent.

We will primarily look at the quality and business impact of partnerships generated, including:

Relevant companies identified Decision-makers contacted Qualified partnership conversations API/White-label opportunities Commercial discussions Signed partnerships Successful integrations

The objective is to build long-term distribution and technology partnerships that allow Link Publishers inventory and link-building capabilities to reach customers through other products and brands.

About Link Publishers

Link Publishers is a link-building marketplace that connects businesses, agencies, and SEO professionals with publishers across multiple industries and markets.

Through our API and white-label solutions, partners can integrate link-building capabilities into their own products or offer link-building services under their own brand while Link Publishers supports the inventory and fulfillment from the backend.

We are looking for someone who can identify where these partnerships make sense and turn those opportunities into scalable business relationships.

Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. jobDescription:
We invite you to come grow with us.

Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, bringing together connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion and precision, we connect insight, strategy and execution to help clients make stronger decisions, accelerate performance and deliver lasting impact for patients. Data, technology and AI enhance this work, alongside the human expertise and judgement that define our advisory offer.

About the India Design Studio

We are establishing an India Design Studio in Gurugram to support Inizio Ignites global teams. The studio will operate as a central design hub, working with business-unit spokes across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and Innovation Growth.

The Design Studio will turn complex strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear, persuasive client stories. It will support high-value business development and client-facing work, including proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority materials.

Our goal is to improve the quality, speed and consistency of these materials; strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise; and build reusable design assets and ways of working that support client delivery and growth.

How quality works in the studio

Quality is shared. Everyone who creates or edits work is accountable for the accuracy and quality of their contribution. Designers complete a structured self-check before handover. The Production QA Assistant provides independent, checklist-based review and delivery control. The Senior Designer provides creative oversight and final design sign-off for priority or high-risk work. Business stakeholders remain accountable for factual content, client requirements and final business approval.

How we use AI

Approved AI and automation tools may be used to support brief understanding, content structuring, asset discovery, layout exploration, tagging and quality checks. They are enabling tools rather than substitutes for design craft. Human judgement, confidentiality, accessibility, brand integrity and final accountability always come first.

Your primary role

Designer - India Design Studio

This role is a developing presentation designer who delivers high-quality, client-facing work within agreed standards and timelines. You will improve the clarity, structure and visual impact of proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks and related materials, while building the judgement and independence required to progress in the team.

What you will do

  • Design and redesign slides, proposal sections, RFP materials, credentials and case studies to improve clarity, visual hierarchy, structure and readability.
  • Apply Inizio Ignite brand standards, PowerPoint templates, visual systems and document standards consistently.
  • Translate clear briefs and developed content into polished visual outputs, escalating gaps or ambiguity early.
  • Adapt existing materials for different audiences, clients, geographies and pursuit contexts.
  • Create reusable slides, diagrams, icons and data visuals.
  • Work with the design team and the Senior Designer on more complex visual storytelling and priority pursuits.
  • Own the quality of your work, complete the studio self-check and resolve issues identified through design review or independent QA.
  • Maintain clean, editable, accessible, well-named and version-controlled files that are ready for handover and reuse.
  • Use approved AI tools responsibly where they improve understanding, exploration or efficiency, while applying independent design judgement to every output.
  • Contribute to asset tagging, template improvement, knowledge capture and shared ways of working.

About you

Your skills and experience

  • Around 2-4 years of experience in presentation design, graphic design, visual design or a similar role, ideally supporting proposals, pitches, RFPs or other client-facing materials.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong layout, visual hierarchy, slide design, brand application and the ability to make complex content easier to understand.
  • Strong PowerPoint skills and working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma or comparable design tools; Think-cell or other charting experience would be useful.
  • Good understanding of typography, templates, design systems, iconography, data visualisation and document polish.
  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to ask focused questions when briefs, priorities or source content are incomplete.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to manage several workstreams within agreed service levels.
  • Practical AI literacy and the judgement to review, refine or reject AI-assisted suggestions before use.
  • Experience with healthcare, life sciences, consulting or professional-services content would be advantageous.

Ideal profile

  • You enjoy turning rough or inconsistent content into clear, polished and client-ready materials.
  • You can work confidently within templates while bringing creativity, clarity and visual thinking.
  • You seek feedback, learn quickly and take increasing ownership as your skills develop.
  • You are collaborative, dependable and motivated to help build a new global design capability.

Career progression

This role sits within the Design Studio career framework of Production QA Assistant, a Design team and Senior Designer. Progression to the next level is based on stronger independent ownership, visual storytelling, stakeholder management, delivery of more complex work and contribution to studio standards - not tenure alone.

tagsAndSkills: adobe creative cloud,client delivery,ai,concurrent,craft,business development,case studies,iconography
jobDescription:
About the India Design Studio

We are establishing an India Design Studio in Gurugram to support Inizio Ignites global teams. The studio will operate as a central design hub, working with business-unit spokes across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and Innovation Growth.

The Design Studio will turn complex strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear, persuasive client stories. It will support high-value business development and client-facing work, including proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority materials.

Our goal is to improve the quality, speed and consistency of these materials; strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise; and build reusable design assets and ways of working that support client delivery and growth.

How quality works in the studio

Quality is shared. Everyone who creates or edits work is accountable for the accuracy and quality of their contribution. Designers complete a structured self-check before handover. The Production QA Assistant provides independent, checklist-based review and delivery control. The Senior Designer provides creative oversight and final design sign-off for priority or high-risk work. Business stakeholders remain accountable for factual content, client requirements and final business approval.

How we use AI

Approved AI and automation tools may be used to support brief understanding, content structuring, asset discovery, layout exploration, tagging and quality checks. They are enabling tools rather than substitutes for design craft. Human judgement, confidentiality, accessibility, brand integrity and final accountability always come first.

Your primary role

Designer - India Design Studio

This role is a developing presentation designer who delivers high-quality, client-facing work within agreed standards and timelines. You will improve the clarity, structure and visual impact of proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks and related materials, while building the judgement and independence required to progress in the team.

What you will do

  • Own the design and delivery of proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority client-facing materials.
  • Translate strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear visual narratives, page structures, diagrams and data stories.
  • Develop credible visual options based on the audience, content maturity, client context and available time.
  • Manage multiple assignments independently, clarify briefs with business stakeholders and flag scope, timing or quality risks early.
  • Apply and reinforce Inizio Ignite brand standards, templates, accessibility requirements and final-file standards.
  • Provide constructive craft feedback and practical support to Designer 1 colleagues, while escalating priority creative decisions to the Senior Designer.
  • Own the quality of your work, complete the studio self-check and resolve issues identified through creative review or independent QA.
  • Create and refine reusable templates, slide components, visual systems, iconography and data-visualisation patterns.
  • Maintain clean, editable, accessible, correctly named and version-controlled files that support reliable handover and future reuse.
  • Use approved AI tools responsibly to accelerate understanding, exploration and production, while ensuring every output is accurate, appropriate and human-reviewed.
  • Contribute to studio standards, onboarding materials, knowledge capture and continuous improvement.

About you

Your skills and experience

  • Around 4+ years of experience in presentation design, visual design, production design or a related creative role, ideally in healthcare, life sciences, consulting, professional services or an agency environment.
  • A strong portfolio showing polished client-facing presentation work, visual storytelling, slide redesign, data visualisation and alternative creative approaches.
  • Advanced PowerPoint skills and strong working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma or similar tools; charting experience would be advantageous.
  • Strong command of layout, typography, hierarchy, information design, brand application and final-file quality.
  • Ability to work directly with stakeholders, challenge unclear briefs constructively and manage expectations across several concurrent requests.
  • Experience giving useful craft feedback or supporting the development of less-experienced designers.
  • Practical AI literacy and the judgement to evaluate AI-assisted outputs critically and responsibly.
  • High attention to detail, strong prioritisation and confidence working under time pressure without compromising core quality standards.
  • Ideal profile
  • You can move comfortably between fast-turn production work and more considered visual storytelling.
  • You take ownership, communicate clearly and know when to involve the Senior Designer or business stakeholder.
  • You enjoy helping others improve and contributing to shared standards, assets and ways of working.
  • You are motivated by the opportunity to shape a new Design Studio and strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise.

Ideal profile

  • You enjoy turning rough or inconsistent content into clear, polished and client-ready materials.
  • You can work confidently within templates while bringing creativity, clarity and visual thinking.
  • You seek feedback, learn quickly and take increasing ownership as your skills develop.
  • You are collaborative, dependable and motivated to help build a new global design capability.

Career progression

This role sits within the Design Studio career framework of Production QA Assistant, a Design team and Senior Designer. Progression to the next level is based on stronger independent ownership, visual storytelling, stakeholder management, delivery of more complex work and contribution to studio standards - not tenure alone.

Further information

This is a full-time role and is expected to follow a hybrid working pattern, based at our Inizio location in Gurugram. The role will support global teams across time zones, so flexibility to work within agreed UK- and US-aligned collaboration windows may be required. The exact reporting line, working pattern and hours will be confirmed during the recruitment process.

As we scale toward our next chapter, we are looking for high-performers who want to do the best work of their careers at the intersection of AI and Cybersecurity.

The Culture Memo: Our Operating System

Safe is not a typical corporate environment. We are a high-intensity, mission-driven team. We value builders who want to define a category and work alongside people who are equally committed to excellence.

  • Extreme Ownership: We don t do "not my job." We hire people who see a gap and own the solution from start to finish.

  • The Elite Standard: We serve the most sophisticated companies on the planet. Our work must be bulletproof. Whether it s a line of code or a sales deck, we aim for Tier-1 quality every time.

  • Methodology & Rigor: We don t wing it. From Force Management and MEDDICC in sales to data-driven sprints in engineering, we rely on proven frameworks to stay disciplined and predictable.

  • Radical Candor: We move too fast for politics or sugar-coating. We value direct, honest feedback that helps us find the right answer quickly.

  • The Series C Hustle: We have the stability of a well-funded leader but the heart of a startup.

The Perks & Ownership:

We want our team to feel like owners because they are owners. We trust our people to manage their results and their time.

  • Meaningful Equity: Every "Safestar" is a shareholder. You aren t just an employee; you are a partner in our success.

  • Unlimited Leaves: We don t believe in clock-watching. We offer unlimited leave because we trust you to take the time you need to recharge while staying committed to the mission.

  • Comprehensive Benefits: We provide top-tier medical insurance and wellness benefits to ensure you and your family are well cared for.

  • Career Trajectory: We are growing aggressively. For high-performers, the path for advancement moves at the speed of your ambition.


As a Staff Engineer Network Security & Attack Path Intelligence, you will define and lead the technical direction of Safe s network reachability and attack-path intelligence capabilities across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments.

You will be the hands-on architect behind systems that connect network topology, identities, vulnerabilities, security controls, and business-critical assets to determine how attackers can move through an enterprise environment.

You ll collaborate with product, backend, graph, data, AI, and platform teams to build scalable, explainable, and enterprise-ready attack-path capabilities.

This is a high-impact, hands-on technical leadership role. You will architect systems, build prototypes, write production-quality code, and help shape how Safe s CTEM platform identifies and breaks the attack paths that pose the greatest business risk.

Core Responsibilities:
  • Architect Safe s Attack Path Intelligence: Define the architecture and data model for network topology, effective reachability, trust boundaries, identities, vulnerabilities, controls, and attack paths across complex enterprise environments.
  • Build Core Attack Path Capabilities: Write production-quality code for network configuration parsing, reachability analysis, attack-graph construction, graph traversal, exposure chaining, and blast-radius computation. Build prototypes and evolve them into reliable, enterprise-scale services.
  • Model Effective Network Reachability: Derive actual connectivity from routing tables, VLANs, ACLs, firewalls, NAT, VPNs, proxies, load balancers, and segmentation policies rather than relying only on documented topology.
  • Model Attacker Movement: Build reasoning systems that connect exposed services, vulnerabilities, credentials, Active Directory privileges, lateral movement, privilege escalation, and access to critical assets.
  • Prioritize Actionable Attack Paths: Distinguish theoretical paths from reachable, exploitable, and business-critical attack paths. Incorporate exploitability, control effectiveness, asset criticality, and business impact into prioritization.
  • Enterprise Security Integrations: Design integrations with firewalls, routers, NAC, EDR, CMDB, Active Directory, vulnerability scanners, NetFlow, cloud platforms, and other enterprise security systems.
  • Countermeasure Intelligence: Build a vendor-neutral model for recommending segmentation, isolation, firewall-policy changes, access-control improvements, and compensating controls. Define validation, approval, safety, and rollback requirements.
  • AI and Graph Integration: Partner with other engineers to ensure attack-path explanations and countermeasure recommendations are evidence-backed, explainable, technically accurate, and governed through deterministic safety policies.
  • Validation & Governance: Build reference attack scenarios, simulation environments, regression datasets, and validation frameworks to verify attack paths and proposed countermeasures without introducing unacceptable operational risk.
  • Mentor & Multiply: Guide backend, graph, security, and platform engineers through architectural design, code reviews, prototypes, engineering standards, and complex security-domain decisions.

Experience: 12+ years of experience in software engineering, network security, security product engineering, exposure management, or related areas, with a strong record of building and shipping production systems.

Core Technical Skills

  • Strong hands-on programming experience in Python, Go, Java, or a similar backend language
  • Recent experience writing and shipping production-quality software not only providing architectural or advisory guidance
  • Strong system-design, API-design, data-modeling, and distributed-systems fundamentals
  • Experience implementing graph traversal, rule-processing, network automation, configuration analysis, or security analytics
  • Ability to independently prototype complex ideas and evolve them into scalable production capabilities
  • Familiarity with graph databases and graph-processing technologies

Network Security

  • Deep understanding of enterprise on-premises, cloud, and hybrid networks
  • Strong knowledge of routing, switching, VLANs, ACLs, firewalls, NAT, VPNs, proxies, load balancers, and network segmentation
  • Experience deriving effective reachability across complex network configurations
  • Understanding of firewall-policy analysis, change validation, control effectiveness, and security misconfiguration detection

Attack Path & Identity Security

  • Strong understanding of Active Directory, Kerberos, identity privilege paths, credential exposure, privilege escalation, and lateral movement
  • Experience with attack graphs, attack-path analysis, threat modelling, breach simulation, or exposure chaining
  • Ability to connect vulnerabilities and misconfigurations with network reachability and attacker behaviour
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK and common enterprise attack techniques

Product Engineering: Experience translating deep security-domain knowledge into scalable products, analytical systems, or security-platform capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience building attack-path, network digital-twin, microsegmentation, or CTEM products
  • Experience with graph databases and large-scale graph computation
  • Experience with BloodHound, Nmap, Zeek, Wireshark, NetFlow, or similar technologies
  • Experience with Forward Networks, XM Cyber, RedSeal, AlgoSec, Tufin, FireMon, or comparable platforms
  • Experience with Palo Alto Networks, Cisco, Fortinet, Check Point, Juniper, or other enterprise network-control technologies
  • Exposure to Pentera, AttackIQ, Picus, Horizon3.ai, or other security-validation platforms

title: Sr. Business Development Representative
jobDescription:
About the Role

As a Senior Business Development Representative, you will play a pivotal role at the front of the sales function by building a high-quality pipeline through targeted outbound prospecting. Working closely with UK-based Account Executives, you will identify, engage and qualify prospective customers, ensuring opportunities are effectively handed over for continued progression.

This is a high-activity role focused on personalised outreach, pipeline generation and maintaining excellent data quality. You will collaborate on account strategy and messaging, continuously refine outbound approaches, and contribute directly to the growth of the business through consistent execution and strong commercial awareness.

Responsibilities

  • Own LinkedIn outbound by running targeted, personalised outreach to CTOs, Heads of Engineering and senior stakeholder buyers.
  • Build a qualified sales pipeline by researching and engaging in-ICP accounts and booking qualified meetings for the UK Account Executive team.
  • Partner closely with UK Account Executives on account strategy, messaging and seamless meeting handover to ensure no opportunities are lost.
  • Conduct first-touch qualification using MEDDPICC principles to identify genuine customer challenges before handing meetings to the Account Executive team.
  • Achieve activity and outcome targets through consistent daily outreach, strong connection and reply rates, and qualified meeting bookings.
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in HubSpot and manage outbound sequences using tools such as HeyReach, Smartlead and Clay/Apollo.
  • Continuously test and optimise outbound messaging and sequences to improve reply rates and conversion performance.

Requirements

  • Industry experience would be a great advantage, with a background in staff augmentation / tech talent as a service, and an understanding of the model, the buyer and the objections.
  • Alternatively, strong experience in tech recruitment and staffing outbound or SDR, with the ability to open a retained, long-term relationship rather than a one-off placement.
  • Alternatively, B2B SaaS or technology SDR/BDR experience selling to CTOs, Heads of Engineering and senior technical buyers.
  • An experienced outbound prospector, ideally LinkedIn-led, within B2B technology or talent.
  • Comfortable prospecting into CTOs, Heads of Engineering and senior technical buyers.
  • An excellent written communicator in English, with a natural, human outbound style, not "spray and pray".
  • Highly organised and able to manage high volume without dropping quality.
  • Familiar with MEDDPICC qualification principles.
  • Self-starting, resilient and target-driven, with the ability to work UK hours alongside a UK-based team.

Benefits

  • Uncapped commission and a clear path to promotions.
  • Fully remote within India, working closely with a London-based team.
  • Generous holiday leave
  • The chance to build your sales career inside a scaling business with global ambition.

Role Summary
The Senior AI & Data Engineer is an individual contributor role that acts as the technical subject matter expert at the intersection of AI engineering and data engineering. This is a uniquely dual-domain role: the successful candidate bridges the organization s data strategy with its AI agenda, ensuring that intelligent systems are built on a foundation of governed, high-quality, well-architected data.
On the AI side, this role designs and delivers end-to-end production-grade AI products architecting multi-agent frameworks, fine-tuning and evaluating LLMs, building robust ML pipelines, and ensuring AI solutions are scalable, explainable, and responsibly governed. On the data side, this role defines the data architecture, transformation standards, and quality frameworks that make those AI products possible owning the data platform across Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and Collibra.
Beyond individual delivery, this role provides technical leadership across cross-functional initiatives, defines engineering standards for both AI and data engineering practice, and leads the Applied AI Engineer and AI Data Engineer. The ideal candidate brings deep expertise across the full stack: from classical machine learning and modern generative AI through to data architecture, governance, and pipeline engineering with the communication skills to translate that expertise into measurable business impact.

Technical Leadership & Subject Matter Expertise

  • Define and uphold engineering standards, design patterns, and best practices across both AI and data engineering disciplines; conduct architecture reviews and provide technical sign-off on all major deliverables.
  • Lead technical discovery for new AI and data use cases: evaluate feasibility, recommend solution approaches, and produce architecture documents for stakeholder alignment.
  • Participate in and lead cross-functional initiatives where AI and data strategy intersect partnering with product, business, and platform teams to translate strategy into shipped solutions.
  • Mentor and upskill the Applied AI Engineer and AI Data Engineer through pair programming, code reviews, design sessions, and structured knowledge transfer.
Advanced LLM Engineering & Agentic AI

  • Assess and implement LLM fine-tuning and alignment strategies where pre-trained models do not meet requirements

Machine Learning & Data Science
  • Lead the full ML lifecycle: problem framing, data strategy, feature engineering, model selection, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
  • Develop advanced ML solutions across NLP, time-series forecasting, anomaly detection, recommendation, and classification/regression domains.
  • Design and implement MLOps pipelines for automated model training, versioning, A/B testing, and drift detection in production environments.
  • Apply statistical rigour hypothesis testing, causal inference, experimental design to validate model outcomes and business impact.
  • Ensure explainability (SHAP, LIME, attention visualization) and fairness assessments are embedded in all production models.

title: Agentic AI Director
jobDescription:
Inviting applications for the role of Agentic Workspace Solution Director in the United States or India.

The Agentic Workspace Solution Director is the strategic leader and senior subject matter expert for Genpact's Agentic Workspace solution. You will support the vision, intellectual property, and go-to-market for how we help enterprise clients reimagine the modern workplace through agentic AI building, configuring, and demonstrating solutions on Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, SharePoint, and Microsoft Foundry, while remaining fluent across the broader agentic ecosystem (Adobe, Opal (Gemini), Anthropic, and beyond).

You will lead Genpact's proprietary IP in this space, Agentic Experience suite, and our Digital Workspace IP Spark Workspace and Spark Connect. You will partner with sales to run demos and hands-on configuration sessions, shape multi-platform proposals, and guide our internal teams in solutioning. Success in this role is measured by growth in Agentic Workspace pipeline and wins, the maturity and adoption of our IP, and the enablement of teams to deliver client outcomes that increase employee productivity and unlock new ways of working.

Responsibilities

Solution Development & Sales Enablement

  • Agentic Workspace Solution Strategy: Collaborate with clients and Genpact sales teams to understand business goals, employee experience pain points, and the operating model the client wants to move toward. Define tailored Agentic Workspace solutions combining Microsoft technologies and translate technical capabilities into executive-friendly value stories with clear linkage to productivity gains, cost takeout, and revenue enablement.
  • (Required) Microsoft Platform Mastery: Serve as Genpact's senior solution SME for the Microsoft agentic stack. Maintain deep, current expertise in Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Power Platform, and Microsoft Foundry. Maintain a deep understanding of Microsoft's agentic roadmap (new releases, private previews, partner programs) and translate that into opportunities for our clients.
  • (Bonus) Multi-Vendor Agentic Fluency: Bring credible, hands-on experience across the broader agentic ecosystem including Adobe, OpenAI, Google, and Anthropic. Advise clients on when to lead with Microsoft, when to compose across vendors, and how to make pragmatic build/buy/compose decisions. Use this fluency to design heterogeneous agent architectures and to position Genpact as a platform-agnostic transformation partner.
  • Sales Demos & Live Configuration: Act as the lead solution architect in the sales cycle for Agentic Workspace opportunities. Run high-impact, customer-facing demos and live configuration sessions. Showcase Agentic Experience suite, Spark Workspace and Spark Connect scenarios in front of client audiences. Drive discovery workshops, craft compelling proposals and RFP responses, scope effort, and coordinate with engineering to validate feasibility (scope, timeline, budget). Your goal is to increase win rate by delivering proposals that are both visionary and credible.

IP Ownership, Go-to-Market & Thought Leadership

  • Agentic Experience Suite IP Leader: Own the roadmap, productization, and evolution of Genpact's Agentic Experience suite. Define the offers, reference architectures, accelerators, and demo assets that make up the suite. Prioritize investment based on client demand and competitive differentiation; and ensure each component has clear value propositions, pricing, and delivery playbooks. Partner with Delivery and Engineering to harden field-built solutions into reusable IP and retire or refactor assets as the agentic landscape evolves.
  • Digital Workspace IP Leader (Spark Workspace & Spark Connect): Serve as the senior product owner for Rightpoint's Digital Workspace IP, including Spark Workspace and Spark Connect. Set the vision and feature roadmap, drive design and engineering priorities, oversee productization and packaging, and ensure tight alignment with the Microsoft platform stack and the broader Agentic Experience suite.
  • Thought Leadership: Be a recognized thought leader internally and externally for Agentic Workspace. Author whitepapers, blog posts, and whitepapers; speak at industry events, Microsoft partner forums, and client roundtables; and contribute to Genpact's brand as a leading agentic systems integrator.
  • Change Management for Agentic Adoption: Recognize that introducing agents into the workplace is a change management challenge as much as a technology one. Advise clients on agent governance, role design, training, and adoption and bake these into the solution so that Agentic Transformation is sustainable, responsible, and measurable.

Success Metrics / KPIs

  • Solution win rate in deals supported (e.g., percentage of proposals with this architect’s designs that convert to project wins), indicating ability to craft compelling, value-aligned architectures.
  • Quality of architecture in delivery: measured by post-implementation results such as performance benchmarks, scalability (can the platform handle expected load), and low incidence of architecture-related issues or rework during build.
  • Client satisfaction and business outcomes attributable to architecture: e.g., a client’s improved site performance or quicker content deployment times due to the designed solution (mapping back to KPIs the architect aimed to achieve).
  • Reusability of designs / accelerators: number of times architecture templates or components (developed under the architect’s guidance) are reused across projects, indicating creation of scalable best practices.
  • Continuous learning: staying certified/up-to-date – for example, maintaining relevant certs and attending partner training; success can be partially measured by completing new certifications or contributing to thought leadership (blogs, tech talks) on multi-platform solutions.

Qualifications we seek in you!

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years in technical architecture roles for digital workspace and employee experience platforms, including substantial hands-on experience with Microsoft products (M365, Copilot, Copilot Studio, SharePoint) in complex enterprise implementations.
  • Microsoft Agentic Platform Mastery: Deep expertise across Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, and Azure AI Foundry, with working knowledge of Power Platform, SAM, Entra, and Purview as they relate to agent governance. Hands-on experience building and configuring agents is required.
  • Customer-Facing Sales & Solution Strength: 10+ years in solution consulting, pre-sales, or digital strategy, including a strong track record of leading executive sales demos and hands-on configuration sessions for enterprise audiences. Proven ability to shape and win large, multi-million-dollar digital transformation programs from discovery through proposal and SOW.
  • IP Ownership Experience: Demonstrated experience owning and evolving productized IP including roadmap definition, packaging, GTM enablement, and field adoption. You understand the difference between a one-off solution and a repeatable asset, and you can build the latter.
  • Digital Workspace Domain Depth: Strong understanding of the modern digital workplace; intranets, employee portals, knowledge management, frontline tooling, and the Microsoft 365 collaboration stack.
  • AI and Digital Innovation Mindset: Demonstrated enthusiasm for and fluency in agentic AI, automation, and emerging tech. You can envision "what's next" for clients and incorporate that into solution plans, positioning Genpact as an innovator.
  • Collaboration & Leadership: Team-oriented leader who thrives in a matrixed consulting environment. Able to lead cross-functional solution teams without formal authority (strategists, UX, engineers, and partner alliance colleagues) toward a unified proposal. Agency or consulting experience strongly preferred.
  • Self-Starter with Organizational Savvy: Entrepreneurial, proactive, and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You manage your own time and priorities across multiple pursuits, develop new ideas with minimal guidance, and exercise sound judgment on when to involve others.

Preferred Certifications & Expertise

  • Microsoft: Microsoft Certified — Azure AI Engineer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or Power Platform Solution Architect Expert. Copilot Studio and Microsoft 365 Copilot enablement badges strongly preferred.
  • Other relevant credentials: TOGAF or equivalent enterprise architecture certification; AWS or GCP architect certifications welcome alongside Azure.
  • Change & Adoption: Prosci or similar Change Management certification is a plus, reflecting ability to guide organizational adoption of agentic AI.

Why Genpact?

  • Make an impact by driving change for global enterprises and solving business challenges that matter
  • Thrive in a values-driven culture

  • Continuous Training, Certifications, and Learning Opportunities
  • Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion: We care about making Genpcat a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive organization to bring about meaningful and measurable changes to representation, team member experience, and client engagement. Our Employee Resource Groups (ERG) are created and run by team members who share a common community, identity, or allyship. These groups play a vital role in contributing to Genpact's inclusive environment where all are valued and empowered to succeed.

We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated Lead SoC Architect to lead the architecture definition and technical direction for next-generation semiconductor products. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in complex SoC architecture development, performance modeling, subsystem integration, and cross-functional collaboration across hardware, software, and system teams.

This role involves defining scalable and high-performance architectures for advanced compute platforms including AI, GPU, multimedia, networking, RISC-V or datacenter-class SoCs. This is a tech lead role. The ideal candidate must be willing to be an individual contributor while leading others.

  • Drive architecture tradeoff analysis for performance, power, area, bandwidth, latency, and scalability.
  • Develop and review system architecture specifications, interface definitions, and microarchitecture requirements.
  • Collaborate with RTL, verification, physical design, firmware, software, and system teams throughout the development cycle.

  • CPU/GPU/NPU architectures

  • High-speed interfaces (PCIe, UCIe, Ethernet)

Technical Skills

  • RTL and microarchitecture understanding
  • AMBA/AXI/CHI protocols

Industry Professionals

The University particularly values candidates who can bridge academia and industry through collaborative research, technology transfer, entrepreneurship, and experiential learning initiatives.

Career Growth

Research Collaboration and Industry Engagement

DAU actively encourages faculty members to pursue collaborative research and innovation initiatives with leading academic institutions, research laboratories, government agencies, and industry partners in India and abroad. title: Lead Generation : Definition & Meaning
tagsAndSkills: conversion optimization,brand building,cold calling,back office,ai,business development,advertising,brand strategy
jobDescription:
Lead generation is the systematic process of identifying and attracting potential customers who demonstrate interest in a company's products or services.

What Is Lead Generation

Marketing teams, sales professionals, and business development specialists use lead generation to build sustainable revenue pipelines, reduce customer acquisition costs, and achieve predictable growth targets through systematic prospect identification and engagement processes.

What Are The Primary Lead Generation Methods Used By Marketing Teams

Marketing teams implement 8 primary lead generation methods to attract and capture qualified prospects. These lead generation approaches are listed below:

  • Content marketing: Organizations create valuable blog posts, whitepapers, ebooks, and educational resources to attract prospects searching for industry solutions and expertise
  • Search engine optimization: Marketing teams optimize website content and landing pages to rank higher in search results for keywords that potential customers use during research phases
  • Pay-per-click advertising: Companies run targeted ads on Google, LinkedIn, Facebook, and other platforms to capture leads actively searching for specific products or services
  • Email marketing campaigns: Organizations send targeted email sequences to newsletter subscribers, webinar attendees, and content downloaders to nurture relationships and generate sales opportunities
  • Webinars and events: Companies host virtual and in-person events, trade shows, conferences, and educational sessions to demonstrate expertise and collect contact information from attendees
  • Referral programs: Businesses incentivize existing customers, partners, and industry contacts to recommend qualified prospects through structured referral systems and reward programs
  • Cold outreach: Sales development representatives contact potential customers through phone calls, LinkedIn messages, and personalized emails based on targeted prospect lists and research

What Are the Types of Lead Generation

Lead generation encompasses 6 primary types that businesses use to attract and capture potential customers. These lead generation approaches are listed below based on their channel characteristics and targeting methods.

  • Content marketing, SEO, social media Attracting prospects through valuable content
  • Cold calling, email campaigns, direct mail Proactively reaching out to potential customers
  • PPC advertising, social ads, display campaigns Capturing leads through online advertising
  • Event-Based Lead Generation Trade shows, webinars, conferences Generating leads through direct engagement
  • Customer referrals, partner networks Leveraging existing relationships for new leads
  • Account-Based Lead Generation Targeted campaigns, personalized outreach Focusing on specific high-value accounts

What Are the Key Components of Lead Generation Systems

Effective lead generation systems contain 5 essential components that work together to identify, capture, and nurture potential customers throughout the sales funnel.

  • Lead Magnets Valuable content offers like whitepapers, ebooks, webinars, or free trials that attract prospects and encourage contact information sharing.
  • Landing Pages Dedicated web pages designed to convert visitors into leads through compelling copy, clear value propositions, and optimized conversion forms.
  • Lead Capture Forms Data collection mechanisms that gather prospect information including name, email, company, and qualifying questions to assess lead quality.
  • Lead Scoring Systems Automated frameworks that assign point values to leads based on demographics, behavior, and engagement level to prioritize sales follow-up.
  • Lead Nurturing Workflows Automated email sequences and content delivery systems that educate prospects and maintain engagement until they reach sales-ready status.

What Is Lead Generation Formula

Lead Conversion Rate Formula

Lead Conversion Rate = (Number of Converted Leads Total Number of Leads) 100

This formula measures how effectively leads progress through the sales funnel, with each variable representing critical performance indicators:

  • Number of Converted Leads represents prospects who completed the desired action, such as making a purchase, signing a contract, or scheduling a consultation within the measurement period.
  • Total Number of Leads includes all qualified prospects who entered the sales funnel during the same timeframe, regardless of their final conversion status.
  • Conversion Rate Percentage indicates the efficiency of the lead nurturing process, with industry benchmarks ranging from 2-5% for most B2B sectors and 1-3% for B2C markets.

Sample Lead Generation Calculation

A software company generates 500 leads through digital marketing campaigns and converts 25 leads into paying customers during Q1.

Step 1: Identify converted leads = 25 customers

Step 2: Identify total leads = 500 prospects

Step 3: Apply formula = (25 500) 100

Step 4: Calculate result = 0.05 100 = 5%

The 5% conversion rate indicates above-average performance for B2B software sales, suggesting effective lead qualification and nurturing processes that convert 1 in every 20 prospects.

Important Considerations

Lead quality varies significantly across acquisition channels, making total volume metrics misleading without segmentation by source, qualification criteria, and conversion timeframes. Track conversion rates separately for each marketing channel to identify the most cost-effective lead generation strategies.

What Are Lead Generation Related Terms

Lead generation intersects with 7 distinct business development concepts that professionals often confuse or misapply. These related terms represent different stages, approaches, and outcomes within customer acquisition strategies.

Key Distinction from Lead Generation Creates market awareness and interest before capturing leads Brand building and market education campaigns Evaluates and scores existing leads for sales readiness Sales process optimization and resource allocation Develops relationships with existing leads over time Marketing automation and customer journey management Complete process from initial contact to paying customer Strategic planning and performance measurement Researches and identifies potential customers before contact Outbound sales strategy and target market analysis Improves rates at which visitors become leads or customers Digital marketing and website performance improvement Tracks and manages entire customer journey from awareness to purchase Sales operations and revenue forecasting

Lead Generation vs. Demand Generation

Lead generation captures contact information from prospects who already show interest, while demand generation creates that initial interest through market education and brand awareness campaigns. Demand generation precedes lead generation in the customer acquisition timeline.

Lead Generation vs. Lead Qualification

Lead generation focuses on quantity by attracting and capturing prospect information, while lead qualification emphasizes quality by evaluating which leads possess genuine purchase intent and budget authority. Qualification follows generation in sales processes.

Lead Generation vs. Lead Nurturing

Lead generation obtains initial prospect contact information through single interactions, while lead nurturing develops ongoing relationships with those prospects through sequential communications over weeks or months until they reach purchase readiness.

Lead Generation vs. Customer Acquisition

Lead generation represents one component within customer acquisition by providing potential buyer contact information, while customer acquisition encompasses the complete journey from initial awareness through final purchase and onboarding activities.

Lead Generation vs. Prospect Development

Lead generation uses inbound methods to attract prospects who voluntarily provide contact information, while prospect development employs outbound research to identify and contact potential customers who have not yet expressed direct interest.

Lead Generation vs. Conversion Optimization

Lead generation creates systems and campaigns to attract potential customers, while conversion optimization analyzes and improves the performance of existing lead generation assets to increase response rates and contact capture efficiency.

Lead Generation vs. Sales Funnel Management

Lead generation feeds prospects into the top of sales funnels through specific acquisition activities, while sales funnel management oversees the entire pipeline from initial contact through closed deals, including lead generation as one input component.

What Are the Core Distinctions Between These Terms

5 fundamental differences separate lead generation from related customer acquisition concepts across timing, scope, and measurement criteria.

  • Timeline Position: Lead generation occurs at specific points in customer journeys, while demand generation happens earlier and customer acquisition spans the entire process from awareness to purchase.
  • Success Metrics: Lead generation measures contact capture.

Track geopolitical events, industry trends, and global cyber incidents that may impact the organizations threat landscape.

  • Develop IO lists , control philosophy documents and functional design specifications (FDS) .

2. Control System Development - Must

    • Power systems: Need to have good understanding of the capacity framework and working design of UPS, LV/MV switchgear, gensets, fuel systems, PDUs

  • Configure and validate PLCs, DDCs, and SCADA servers (Schneider / Siemens / Rockwell / Honeywell).

  • Implement interoperability via BACnet/IP, Modbus TCP/IP, OPC-UA , and MQTT brokers for telemetry aggregation.

  • Oversee integration testing with DCIM , AIops , or energy optimization platforms.

  • Align systems to IEC 62443 or equivalent cybersecurity compliance framework.

    • Integrate AI models for predictive control.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Quality Engineering
jobDescription:
Your Role

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Platform team, you will build and own the frameworks, tooling, and CI/CD infrastructure that let Alpaca s engineers ship new features quickly and reliably. This is a software engineering role at its core: you will spend most of your time writing Go, designing automated test frameworks, and digging into application code and Kubernetes when needed. Just as importantly, you will help redefine how we use AI to raise the bar on quality - leveraging LLMs and AI-driven tooling to generate tests, catch regressions before they ship, and turn every incident into durable, automated coverage. We are looking for engineers who treat quality as an engineering discipline and see AI as a force multiplier for it - people who build the systems that make testing fast, reliable, and effortless for the teams that depend on them.

Things You Get To Do
  • Design and build automated test frameworks across our REST and gRPC API surface.
  • Leverage AI and LLM-based tooling to accelerate test generation, harden regression coverage, and turn production incidents into automated tests - embedding these practices into the frameworks the whole engineering org relies on.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines - we use a mix of GitHub Actions and Google Cloud Build.
  • Design and execute load, stress, and scalability tests to ensure our platform can handle growing demand.
  • Introduce chaos engineering practices - designing fault-injection and resilience experiments that surface failure modes before our customers do.
  • Standardize tooling and infrastructure to improve the day-to-day developer experience.
  • Partner with other teams to raise test coverage, reliability, and speed across services.
  • Dig into application code to root-cause failures and drive fixes to completion.
  • Mentor and guide product engineers, fostering a culture of quality and continuous improvement.
Who You Are (Must-Haves)
  • You have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer building and maintaining production systems.
  • You have written code in strongly typed languages and have at least 1 year of experience with Go.
  • You are fluent with AI-assisted engineering - you actively use LLM-based tools in your workflow and have a clear point of view on where they elevate quality (and where they don t).
  • You have built and maintained CI pipelines before - ideally with GitHub Actions or Google Cloud Build.
  • You have designed and built automated test frameworks, and you understand the challenges microservices pose for reliable integration and end-to-end testing.
  • You are familiar with Kubernetes beyond the basics - you can write a Helm chart for a new service with relative ease, you understand best practices around security, and you have prior job experience or certifications to prove this.
  • You have worked at a startup before - you understand that things don t always go according to plan, that there is significant technical debt, that some tasks just need to be done, and that sometimes there are no processes or documentation to guide your hand.
  • You are not afraid of taking a task from start to finish - gathering requirements, figuring out and implementing the best technical solution, then deploying and monitoring the results.
Who You Might Be (Bonus Points)
  • You have used AI/LLM tooling to build QA automation - test generation, flaky-test triage, or incident-to-regression pipelines - and can speak to what worked and what didn t.
  • You have written code in Python or TypeScript, and can build efficient Dockerfiles and secure container images.
  • You have implemented load tests with k6 (REST) and ghz (gRPC) and have experience analyzing pprof/trace output.
  • You have done IaC deployments with Argo CD or Terraform, or have used Google Cloud Platform and Google Kubernetes Engine before. You are familiar with Tilt and have written a Kubernetes Operator before.
  • You have practiced chaos engineering - running fault-injection or resilience experiments with tools like Chaos Mesh, LitmusChaos, or Gremlin.
  • You are familiar with testing event-driven systems using Kafka (or even better, Redpanda).

jobDescription:
ABOUT UA/UNIFORM ADVANTAGE BRANDS

For over 40 years, UA Brands has designed fashion-forward apparel for the medical and culinary professionals who make a difference every day. We re proud to support the people behind the work, those showing up and making an impact every shift. We re a purpose-driven team with a strong commitment to community, collaboration, and service. Here, you ll find a culture that values connection, fresh perspectives, and real impact. From the start, we re committed to giving you an authentic look at life at UA Brands and how you can grow, contribute, and make your mark.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This role follows a permanent work schedule of 6:00 PM to 3:00 AM IST, Monday through Friday.

We are looking for an applied AI and automation engineer to build and ship practical tools that make UA s operations faster and more reliable. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused role: the person takes problems and priorities defined by leadership and turns them into working software AI agents, automations, scripts, and integrations that connect our systems and remove manual work. Success is measured by what ships and the results it produces, not by research or strategy. A core part of the job is technical judgment: knowing when a problem genuinely needs AI versus when a simpler, reliable rule-based tool is the right answer, and building accordingly.

Initial work centers on UA s AI and automation roadmap: building and deploying managed AI agents for operations use cases such as order and return exception handling and inbound document processing, automating manual B2B and customer-service workflows, and integrating these solutions with existing systems including Dynamics AX, Zoom Contact Center, and Microsoft 365. The role works under the direction of the Project Manager and partners with IT, operations, and outside vendors to scope and deliver.

WHAT YOU LL DO

  • Build, test, and deploy AI agents and automations for prioritized operations use cases (e.g., order and return exception handling; inbound document processing against Dynamics AX).
  • Build deterministic automation tools and scripts where business logic is rule-based (e.g., conditional product removal, dormant account review), reserving AI for inputs that are genuinely unstructured.
  • Collaborate with IT, operations, and outside vendors to scope, validate, and prioritize automation opportunities.
  • Document builds, configurations, and runbooks, and support handoff to operations and other teams.
  • Evaluate vendor and platform AI capabilities to inform build-versus-buy decisions and avoid duplicating features already on a vendor roadmap.
  • Develop and maintain integrations between AI/automation solutions and existing systems (Dynamics AX 2012 R3 via SFTP, Zoom Contact Center, Microsoft 365).
  • Automate manual operations and workflows (e.g., Pardot form and order entry, alerting and escalation routing).
  • Test, monitor, and report on the accuracy, performance, and ROI of deployed AI and automation solutions; flag and resolve failures.
  • Maintain, debug, and improve tools already running in production.
  • Translate leadership objectives and business requirements into technical specifications and working prototypes.

REQUIRED SKILLS

  • Advanced proficiency in Python (or an equivalent programming language) for developing automations, scripts, and system integrations.
  • Sound judgment to determine when a problem is best addressed using AI versus deterministic or rule-based solutions.
  • Strong experience in debugging, testing, deploying, and monitoring production-grade solutions.
  • Proficiency in API and data integration, including file-based exchanges, SFTP, and integrations with legacy applications and ERP systems.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-powered solutions using LLM APIs and agent frameworks, including prompt engineering, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and tool/function calling.
  • Highly self-directed, with the ability to consistently deliver high-quality outcomes with minimal supervision.
  • Hands-on experience with SQL and structured data management.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications, solution designs, and functional prototypes.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor s degree or equivalent demonstrated experience with a Specialization or Major in Computer Science or Data Science or Computer Engineering or equivalent stream.

TYPE OF EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

More than 2 years of hands-on experience in:

  • Designing, developing, and deploying AI-powered or automation solutions in production environments (beyond academic projects, prototypes, or demonstrations).
  • Integrating systems and data through APIs, SFTP/file-based exchanges, and legacy or ERP platforms.
  • Building and implementing solutions using LLM APIs and agent frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications:

Candidates with hands-on experience using LLM APIs and agent frameworks (such as LangChain or LangGraph), along with experience integrating AI solutions with ERP and legacy enterprise systems, will be given preference.

WHERE YOU LL WORK - PERMANENT WORK FROM HOME (India)

This is a permanent remote role based in India, allowing you to work exclusively from your home within India, with no daily commute.

Remote employees are expected to be available and actively working during their teams designated core business hours to ensure effective collaboration. The company will provide all required computer equipment for business use.

This role may require occasional business travel to our U.S. headquarters, located in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. Situated in one of the countrys most scenic coastal destinations, Fort Lauderdale is known for its beautiful beaches, vibrant waterfront, and year-round warm climate. Candidates who already hold a valid U.S. Business Visa (B1/B2) will have an advantage.

WORKSPACE REQUIREMENTS

WHY YOU LL LOVE WORKING HERE
